item.p: Specifications: Invisible XML Specification 1.0 (invisiblexml.org, 2022: the ixml grammar, marks and insertions, ambiguity reported as ixml:state="ambiguous", failures as ixml:state="failed"); F&O 4.0, fn:invisible-xml (the grammar argument, options fail-on-error; the result function; FOIX0001, FOIX0002).
Unlocks: QT4 fn-invisible-xml 10 (of 16); and the iXML community test suite, if vendored (owner question 4: several hundred grammar and parse tests).
Replaces: the function is absent (XPST0017), and supports-invisible-xml is false.
one Earley parser (glossary ) over a compiled iXML grammar (glossary ), with explicit item sets in allocator memory;
the iXML grammar of iXML itself is compiled in as constant tables, so the same engine reads grammars and inputs;
the first parse tree is serialized as builder events with marks applied.
Grammars are run-time data, so gives way to 's reasoning, recorded in the packet's D-record.
Owns: new src/ixml.c, src/ixml_internal.h, src/ixml_earley.c and src/function_library_ixml.c; the suite under third_party/ixml-tests if the owner agrees.

Gate: all 16 QT4 cases; ≥ 90 % of the suite's correct-grammar tests. Done 2026-10-19 (), gate met: QT4 fn-invisible-xml 16 of 16 (XP40, XQ40); the iXML community suite (vendored, third_party/ixml-tests) 886 of 907, test cases with a correct grammar 711 of 715 (99.4 %), grammar tests 142 of 142. sxml-full.wasm +39,704 bytes (stripped); sxml.wasm unchanged but for 4 bytes.
